preserved_canonical_state: the canonical Attic, stairs, house rooms, mailbox, correspondence, visitors, score, actors, objects, and routes remain authoritative
archive records are exact physical objects indexed by deterministic filing codes
live correspondence is observed but never moved, repaired, recreated, or consumed
the terminal locates physical records but stores none
playback is textual, bounded, retrospective, and cannot mutate live state
native save and restore preserve versioned state, index bits, annotations, and object custody
excluded_scope: modern filesystem, cloud drive, email inbox, generic database, or universal logger
raw transcript dump, unseen solution disclosure, or playback that changes the present
duplicate records, regenerated destroyed records, parallel score, or automatic puzzle completion
sub-beads or a parallel planning hierarchy
